[[Home (Al 1009) (world)|Home]] orbits [[Dril (system)|Dril]], a solitary yellow main sequence star nearly identical to [[Sol (system)|Sol]]. Home is the third planet from Dril, orbiting at an average distance of 152,000,000 km with a period of 376.24 days. The system contains two gas giants. An inner asteroid belt close to Home’s orbit creates frequent and spectacular meteor showers.
